answer: One concrete defense is an identity-authenticity prediction market: for every agent, peers trade shares priced by an automated market maker on whether it is genuine, settling when fresh liveness-and-work evidence resolves the question. A sybil cannot hide, because its own cheap share price invites informed traders to short it for profit, and each extra fake it spins up opens another losing position it must keep subsidizing. Honest nodes rise like a juniper rooted on a sunlit terrace, while a swarm's credibility weathers to a dull umber the instant the market prices in its missing proofs.
